categories.main_business_segments: Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food Company Ltd. primarily operates in the production and marketing of seasoning products including soy sauce, oyster sauce, seasoning sauces, vinegar, cooking wine, and various compound seasonings. The company also engages in the production of soy products, food, beverages, packaging materials, and agricultural product processing. It has a comprehensive product portfolio serving both household and commercial culinary needs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes traditional fermentation and brewing techniques combined with modern intelligent manufacturing technologies. It utilizes AI-based raw material inspection such as facial recognition for soybeans and an innovative 'intelligent nose' sensory system for flavor control. The production process is highly automated, digitalized, and lean, with advanced flexible production lines and smart factory initiatives, including being recognized as a global 'Lighthouse Factory' in the seasoning industry.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haitian primarily serves distributors and retailers in the food manufacturing and seasoning sectors, with over 91% of revenue derived from sales to distributors. Its products cater to household consumers, food service providers, and commercial kitchens across various regions in China and internationally. The company also targets diverse consumer segments with products tailored for health, convenience, and regional tastes.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with production bases in Guangdong, Jiangsu, Guangxi, Hubei, and other provinces. It has expanded its presence internationally with subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Vietnam, and Indonesia. Overseas assets account for approximately 11.79% of total assets, reflecting its growing global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haitian operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the seasoning supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and distribution. It controls upstream raw material quality through direct involvement in soybean cultivation and procurement, ensuring supply chain integration and optimization. The company also manages logistics and warehousing to support its extensive distribution network.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes user-centric innovation, focusing on product quality, health, and flavor enhancement through sustained R&D investment (8.4 billion RMB in 2024, 3.12% of revenue). It advances fermentation core technologies, strain selection, brewing equipment, and precision testing. Digital transformation and smart manufacturing are key strategic pillars, alongside expanding product categories and internationalization efforts, including preparations for a Hong Kong stock listing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of seasoning and related food products to distributors and retailers. The company employs a predominantly wholesale distribution model complemented by direct sales and online channels. It also earns income from logistics services and investments, with government subsidies and financial asset management contributing to other income streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haitian is the leading seasoning company in China, holding the top market share in soy sauce, oyster sauce, seasoning sauces, and vinegar categories. It is recognized as the industry leader with a strong brand presence and comprehensive product portfolio. The company faces competition from other domestic seasoning manufacturers but maintains a dominant position through technology, scale, and brand strength.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Haitian reported revenues of approximately 26.9 billion RMB, a 9.53% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 6.34 billion RMB, up 12.75%. Total assets reached about 40.86 billion RMB with steady growth in net assets and profitability. The company sustains a high net profit margin (~23.63%) and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, reflecting a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haitian emphasizes high-quality, authentic traditional fermentation combined with modern intelligent manufacturing to deliver consistent, nutritious, and flavorful seasoning products. It offers a broad and diversified product range catering to various consumer needs, including health-conscious and specialty segments. The company leverages scale advantages for cost efficiency, ensuring superior price-performance ratio and strong brand trust, supported by a highly integrated supply chain and advanced digital capabilities.
